steps.text: View WU Fraud message   ,  Click on New Beneficiary

Select delivery method 
 a. Money In Minutes 
 b. Direct to Bank  
 c. Mobile Money Transfer

options.option:
Money In minutes :
 - Beneficiary Mobile country code  
 - Beneficiary Mobile number

Direct to Bank  :
  - Bank Name  
 - Account Number 
 - District 
 - Branch Name  
 - Receiver’s mobile country code 
 - Receiver mobile number

Mobile Money Transfer : 
 - Mobile wallet name  
 - Receiver mobile country code 
 - Receiver mobile number

steps.text:
Fill in Beneficiary Details (Common Details) 
  a. Beneficiary first name  
 b. Beneficiary last name  
 c. Beneficiary Nationality  
  d. Select purpose of transfer 
 then  Fill in beneficiary details per delivery method
Enter OTP  , then Review successful message
